behaviorCovered: One SQL snapshot returns unchanged spending totals plus a derived aggregate assessment across descendants, settled steps, title/compaction usage and S1 rows.
Unknown pricing dominates legacy provenance, then estimates and reported costs; empty means no recorded usage, not an invoice assertion.
Imported totals without matching usage facts remain legacy; numeric fold residue has a small tolerance. Historical amounts are not repriced.
Actual fork tests keep inherited assistant history out of new spending, and committed revert retains prior recorded costs.
Shared SDK reads are lazy, coalesce bursts, refresh for zero-valued usage on an unloaded child, and clear their snapshots on eviction.
TUI production components render qualified costs at 44 and 120 columns; narrow live activity preserves the new-session action.
Production GUI header and Context panel update unknown, partial, estimated, legacy and provider-reported zero states through the real shared client and fixture transport.
ACP wire tests omit incomplete/legacy cumulative costs while retaining knownSubtotal, USD, status and scope in reddb.io/cost metadata.
Optional public metadata retains old response compatibility; generated Client outputs and canonical namespace identity are verified.
limits: No paid inference, deployed browser/server validation, invoice reconciliation, remote CI, push or publication.
S1 currently lacks typed reported-versus-estimated provenance; available numeric S1 records are conservatively legacy, unresolved ones unknown.
Default/bundled catalog remains V1. Detailed provider media/cache meters, Mini step-cost presentation and validated V2 default cutover remain pending.
Unknown costs do not imply free usage and do not guarantee an external dollar cap; spending policy is unchanged.
Only the focused suites listed here ran, not the entire repository test suite. The requested GUI lint script is unavailable; its explicit replacement is recorded above.
